target.role: Director, Investment Risk and Equity Valuation

summary: Investment risk and valuation specialist with ~7 years of experience in independent model challenge, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and valuation review - directly relevant to the Director, Investment Risk and Equity Valuation mandate at Canada Infrastructure Bank. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics over valuation and sensitivity outputs for multi-asset (fixed income and derivative) institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, and sits on the model governance committee setting methodology and documentation standards. Earlier ALM, LDI and VaR/CVaR portfolio-optimization advisory at Ortec Finance, including investment-committee delivery. CFA charterholder; dual MSc degrees; conversational French.
core_skills: Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Fundamentals & Discount Rate/Curve Assumption Review

sections.heading: Valuation Review & Independent Challenge
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority over valuation, sensitivity and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative across the book), spanning fixed income and derivative exposures.

Challenge key valuation inputs prior to production release - discount rates and curve assumptions implied by yield-curve construction, spread calibration and cross-asset interactions - and escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.

Validate derivatives valuation outputs across rates, FX and inflation, confirming sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates and reviewing aggregation logic from security-level exposures to portfolio risk metrics.
Serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, working directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Valuation Methodology, Governance & Documentation
bullets: Contribute to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards as a member of the model governance committee, including model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls, supporting documentation and reproducibility standards for recurring model review.

sections.heading: Scenario Analysis, Sensitivity Testing & Cash Flow Modelling
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress and reverse-stress scenarios, providing forward-looking visibility over long-horizon projected cash flows.

Embedded behavioural cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic and macro stress overlays, and ran independent scenario analysis and sensitivity testing of portfolio exposure under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks.

sections.heading: Reporting & Mentorship
bullets: Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on scenario impacts, valuation sensitivities and exposure, translating complex analytical outputs into concise, decision-ready narratives; mentored junior colleagues on review practice.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers and consulting firms on the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms - advising on asset, liability and portfolio configurations and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Translated investment-team requirements into scoped development requests and migrated all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning measurement requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT and program-management functions, and contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes for financial institutions.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk analysis and near-optimal frontier testing of allocation robustness.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators, producing distributions of funding and return outcomes under base-case and stressed environments.
Delivered ALM and investment studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch and long-horizon balance-sheet risk.
Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis plus cash flow, liquidity and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation and currency risk for international institutional clients.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger - on a team of three building and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations to pension-fund investment committees on-site, and designed stochastic risk-management frameworks tailored to specific client mandates.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
